t: A $(item)Collector Drone/$ is a specialized non-programmable type of $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ which should be deployed against, or next to, any inventory block (chest etc.). It will collect nearby items and put them in that inventory.
$(item)采集无人机/$是一种专门的、不可编程的$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$，应部署在任意容器方块（如箱子等）上或其旁边。它会收集附近的物品并将其放入该容器中。

As with all types of Drone, these drones require $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ to operate, and will automatically seek out $(l:tools/drone#charging)a Charging Station with a Dispenser Upgrade/$ if low on air.
与所有类型的无人机一样，这些无人机需要$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$才能运作，并且在气压不足时会自动寻找$(l:tools/drone#charging)装有发射器升级的充气站/$。

The $(thing)Collector Drone/$ has some basic item filtering functionality. If deployed $(italic)against/$ an inventory block, it will filter on any items already in that inventory. If deployed on the ground $(italic)next to/$ an inventory (or on an empty inventory block), it $(italic)won't/$ filter items.$(p)If you want to change the drone's filter, you will need to wrench it and redeploy it.
$(thing)采集无人机/$具备一些基础的物品筛选功能。如果将其$(italic)紧贴着/$一个容器方块部署，它会根据该容器中已有的物品进行筛选。如果将其部署在地面上，并放在容器$(italic)旁边/$（或部署在一个空的容器方块上），它$(italic)不会/$筛选物品。$(p)如果你想更改无人机的筛选条件，就需要用扳手拆下它并重新部署。

The $(thing)Collector Drone/$ has a default range of a 17x17x17 cube, centered on the block it was placed at. This range can be increased by adding up to 16 $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#range)Range Upgrades/$.
$(thing)采集无人机/$的默认范围是一个以其放置位置方块为中心的 17x17x17 立方体。添加最多 16 个$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#range)范围升级/$可扩大该范围。
